notes.note: Sanders has been popular amongst the SuperCoach circles in recent weeks but this week was a victim of the Dogs poor performance with his efficiency at 57% for his 7 kicks and 12 handballs. His BE is now very high and he is one that if you want him you should wait until after that bye.

Sanders is turning into a player that we must consider for our forward line as he has been putting up some good scores of late and this week was no exception with 23 disposals and 7 clearances. Certainly watch him for after his bye.
